input.content: Compare supplier 1 performance with its contract.

request.instructions: Use the supplied tools for business evidence.

tools.name: resolve_business_entity
tools.description: Resolve names or numeric IDs using actual records. Multiple matches require clarification. Order/incident references are numeric IDs; do not invent reference formats.

tools.name: get_enterprise_overview
tools.description: Executive operations metrics with explicit units and observation window.

tools.name: get_procurement_performance
tools.description: Purchase order cohorts, full receipts, overdue commitments and recorded prices.

tools.name: compare_suppliers
tools.description: Supplier comparison. Sort by supported metrics; preserve reliability, cost and target separately.

tools.name: get_supplier_performance
tools.description: One verified supplier, including effective contractual SLA assessments. Below target is not legal breach.

tools.name: get_inventory_status
tools.description: Ledger stock, receipts, dispatches and shortage exposure; no reservations.

tools.name: get_warehouse_performance
tools.description: Warehouse inventory, delays, incidents and recorded costs; no invented utilization.

tools.name: get_customer_fulfilment
tools.description: Customer dispatch commitments, full/partial fulfilment and overdue demand.

tools.name: get_operational_costs
tools.description: Exact GBP invoice exposure, payments and explicitly attributed additional costs; no profit or recovered penalties.

tools.name: get_workforce_tasks
tools.description: Owned task workload and observed completion history. Not an employee productivity score.

tools.name: get_operational_incidents
tools.description: Incident incidence/prevalence and corrective actions; historical escalation may be unavailable.

tools.name: get_deterministic_insights
tools.description: Transparent backend threshold signals, not a substitute for deeper investigation.

tools.name: investigate_business_entity
tools.description: Bounded source-record relationships. Narrow tasks/costs/receipts/incident selectors preserve direct attribution; all-graph associations are not costs or proven causes.

tools.name: search_corporate_knowledge
tools.description: Search actual effective corporate sources using the accepted lexical/vector/hybrid engine. Use OR/quoted phrases for cross-document requests and metadata for supplier scope.

tools.name: build_knowledge_context
tools.description: Build a bounded verified source context with untrusted-data metadata, without generating an answer.

tools.name: get_document_details
tools.description: Preview a registered document/version effective as of this run. No path inputs.

tools.name: resolve_source_citation
tools.description: Resolve an actual registered chunk citation and verify original source lines/hash.

text.description: Qualitative finding only. No digits, numeric entity IDs or number words. Use 'the supplier' rather than a numbered name. Put all quantities in metric_refs.
text.title: Text

limitations.description: Qualitative limitations only: no digits, dates, numeric IDs, document codes or spelled-out numbers. An empty list is allowed.
limitations.title: Limitations

follow_up_questions.description: Qualitative questions only: no digits, dates, numeric IDs, document codes or spelled-out numbers. An empty list is allowed.
follow_up_questions.title: Follow Up Questions

summary.text:
The user wants to compare supplier 1's performance with its contract. To do this, I need to:

1. First resolve "supplier 1" to get the actual supplier ID
2. Get supplier performance data for supplier 1
3. Search or build knowledge context about the contract for supplier 1
4. Compare the performance metrics with the contract terms

Let me start by resolving supplier 1 to get the actual supplier ID, then I'll need to get the supplier performance and contract information.

I'll need to use:
- resolve_business_entity to find supplier 1's actual ID
- get_supplier
